Hon'ble Karunesh Singh Pawar,J.
Heard  learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA for the State and perused the record.
It is alleged in the prosecution case that Israr Ahmad on 06/7.11.2022 in the night forcibly entered into the house of the complainant and molested her.
When daughter of the complainant started crying, the informant wake up and saw that the applicant forcibly by making her sit on the bike and went towards Tulsipur.

The whole incident was told by the informant to her son then he went to Tulsipur on his motorcycle and told the relative of the complainant Khuddus and thereafter Khuddus took Umesh (son of the complainant) to his sister where he was beaten by the accused Israr Ahmad (applicant).
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the victim as per her statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C. is a consenting party.

She has admitted her relationship with the applicant for the past one Israr @ Israr Ahmad @ Kallu vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/155200375/

sentences.text: No allegation of rape has been made by her against the applicant while giving statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C.
No injury has been found or seen over the body of the victim in her medical examination.
There is lack of corroborative medical evidence.
There is no evidence of forcible sexual assault.
In the ossification test, age of the victim has been found to be 16.5 years.

It has been further submitted that margin of error in ascertaining age by radiological examination is two years on either side as held by Supreme Court in Jaya Mala versus Home Secretary,
Government of Jammu & Kashmir and others (1982)2 SCC 538 and the applicant being the accused is entitled for giving the benefit on higher side.
It is further submitted that the applicant is languishing in jail since 08.11.2022 without having any criminal antecedent.

sentences.text: There is no possibility of the applicant of fleeing away after being released from jail or tampering with the witnesses.
In case the applicant is enlarged on bail, he shall not misuse the liberty of bail.

Learned AGA has opposed the bail application submitted that the victim is minor 14 years old,
however, he could not dispute the fact that the victim has made contradictory statements.

On due consideration to the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. wherein no allegation of rape has been alleged by her; lack of corroborative medical evidence or any other corroborative material; charge sheet has been filed in this case; there is no chance of tampering,
coupled with the fact that the applicant, coupled with the fact that the applicant is languishing in jail since 08.11.2022 without having any criminal antecedent and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I find it to be a fit case for enlarging the applicant on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant, Israr @ Israr Ahmad @ Kallu, involved in Case Crime/FIR No. 80/2022, under Sections 363/323/452/506/366/376 IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act, Police Station - Jarwa,
District - Balrampur, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions which are being imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will not pressurize/ intimidate the prosecution witness.
(iii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
